notes.title: ScreamFest Discount - Upcoming Price Slashing
notes.notes:
Thanks for checking Feywing out. Feywing was released October 31, 2023. A year later, we find we don't have the time to go back and fix some issues, and will probably just remake with better practices and modern tooling. Feywing was initially written as a small experiment and is our "zeroth" release.

As of writing, the 2024 ScreamFest is active, and we slashed the price to as low as we could on Steam. After the event, it'll be made free since we don't have time to update it. You can refund if you qualify and would like. You can currently get Feywing on itch for free as well, which includes a small PDF featuring notes of the game, developer commentary, and other fun stuff.

If you'd like to see other stuff we're making, you can check our dragon JRPG Crop and Claw on Steam and itch, and keep up with future projects on the Discord: https://discord.gg/D3ttpCkmyk
